description: Semantic mutations for Config string import, typed ownership, and indexed option access.

DynamicConfig copy\, move\, plus\, swap\, and erase preserve ownership
mutants.description: Ignore the incoming same-type lvalue value in +=; the assertion that the destination count becomes 12 fails before any rvalue merge.

mutants.old: int&                opt_int(const t_config_option_key &opt_key, unsigned int idx)           { return this->option<ConfigOptionInts>(opt_key)->get_at(idx); }
mutants.new: int&                opt_int(const t_config_option_key &opt_key, unsigned int idx)           { return this->option<ConfigOptionInts>(opt_key)->get_at(idx - 1); }
